arguments.query_text: Read per-section collision flags on the imported balcony decks; complex-as-simple is set but the player falls through them.
arguments.python_script:
import unreal,json
s=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.StaticMeshEditorSubsystem); rows=[]
for n in ['SM_MallBalconyStraight_400','SM_MallBalconyModule_400']:
 m=unreal.load_asset('/Game/Environment/Mall/Models/Architecture/'+n); rows.append({'mesh':n,'simple_count':s.get_simple_collision_count(m),'sections':[{'index':i,'collision':s.is_section_collision_enabled(m,0,i)} for i in range(m.get_num_sections(0))]})
unreal.log(json.dumps(rows))
